title: Water NbS Story Radar
summary: Daily shortlist of practical stories for surface water quality, aquatic ecology, and water-related biodiversity.
detail: A curation tool for finding Ireland-relevant Water NbS stories and useful practice signals. Built around practical catchment, surface-water, ecological, and biodiversity relevance rather than generic green news.

title: Catchment Pulse Ireland
summary: Live and latest Irish water-quality signals for hydrometry, bathing quality, WFD context, groundwater and marine shore indicators.
detail: A map-first GitHub Pages PWA backed by scheduled public-data harvests. It separates live hydrometry from latest chemistry, WFD context and historical groundwater or marine datasets, with Baldoyle Bay, Howth, Portmarnock, Malahide and Nanny-Delvin as configured focus areas.

title: Urban Forest
summary: Case-study microsite for the Trinity Urban Forest, with a daily urban-forest news radar.
detail: A public-facing case study documenting the Urban Forest intervention, species, milestones, carbon scenario, gallery, wellbeing value, evidence base, README, and the UrbanForest News subsite.

title: European Bird Sounds
summary: Educational bird sound explorer for learning calls by place, habitat, and season across Europe.
detail: A mobile-first sound explorer for training the ear. It combines public bird sounds, images, habitat-aware local listening decks, and recent observations as educational context. It is not a scientific record or species survey.

title: Ireland Energy Transition Monitor
summary: Live-style dashboard for Ireland’s electricity mix, demand, interconnection, renewable capacity, and transition indicators.
detail: Tracks operational electricity data and transition context in a public dashboard. Designed to make system-level energy signals easier to understand without losing technical integrity.

title: Irish Life Pension Funds
summary: Daily public-data watchlist for selected Irish Life Pension Funds.
detail: A static GitHub Pages monitor backed by a scheduled scraper. It tracks public Irish Life/myBline fund rows where available, records coverage diagnostics, and keeps a local history file for daily movement over time.

title: Grant Radar
summary: Funding and call discovery layer for climate, nature, biodiversity, water, and community environmental work.
detail: A source-led catalogue and review workflow for spotting relevant opportunities, separating candidates from promoted items, and reducing missed calls.

title: Nanny-Delvin Rivers Trust Microsite
summary: Catchment-facing microsite concept for river restoration, citizen science, monitoring, and practical local action.
detail: A public communication space for catchment restoration ideas, field interpretation, citizen science, water quality, and restoration-led engagement.

title: Current Nanny-Delvin Rivers Trust Website
summary: Forward to the dedicated Trust-hosted website; the original Salmon of Doubt prototype remains available separately.
detail: The continuing Nanny-Delvin Rivers Trust website in its dedicated GitHub organisation, separate from the original Salmon of Doubt prototype.

title: SDSS Concept
summary: Spatial Decision Support System concept for prioritising Nature-based Solution portfolios in Irish catchments.
detail: A methodological demonstrator for transparent rule formalisation, suitability logic, ranking stability, and explainable catchment-scale NbS planning.

title: River Basin Boundary Explorer
summary: Interactive fractal-boundary experiment with a clear place-perturb-observe river analogy.
detail: A genuine three-attractor Newton fractal with a guided nearby-points experiment, stable non-jittering rendering, selectable starting conditions, visible storm and intervention movements, four Irish river contexts and an explicit distinction between mathematical demonstration and calibrated river evidence.

title: Simple Rules Explorer
summary: Interactive laboratory for distinguishing order, emergent complexity, deterministic chaos and fractal structure from simple rules.
detail: Four playable experiments: Reynolds-style flocking for order and emergence, a logistic-map divergence laboratory for deterministic chaos, and Sierpinski chaos-game plus Newton-basin explorers for fractal iteration and sensitive boundaries. Each experiment includes disturbances, diagnostics and explicit limits on what the visual behaviour proves.

title: Three Intelligences Explorer
summary: Exploratory model linking individual, collective, and planetary intelligence.
detail: A systems-thinking prototype inspired by planetary intelligence concepts, using indicators to provoke discussion rather than produce simplistic rankings.

title: Dublin Representative Finder
summary: Compact civic lookup tool for finding Dublin political representatives and public-contact routes.
detail: A practical civic-information demo for helping people identify relevant Dublin representatives, understand who to contact, and navigate local democratic representation more easily.

title: Geo Radar
summary: Geospatial discovery and catalogue-style workflow for spatial data or environmental intelligence.
detail: A radar-style prototype for organising geospatially relevant sources and making discovery workflows more systematic.

title: Colour Lab
summary: Small visual experiment for testing interface colour, contrast, and presentation treatments.
detail: An experimental design-support page for exploring visual treatments. Kept public as a utility/prototype rather than a formal research output.

title: Tax Trigger
summary: Experimental public explainer/demo for tax-trigger style reasoning.
detail: A lightweight demonstrator for structuring tax-trigger logic. It is not financial, legal, or tax advice and should be treated as an experimental explanatory tool only.
